reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share some significant updates to the movement mechanics in Provincia! Formation drags now face the direction you pull, and soldiers will only slide without any teleportation. This means a more realistic and tactical experience as your units march and engage in battle. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
